metadata.title: LetsAimIt: 120 search query and content-coverage candidates
metadata.verification_notice: This is an exactly 120-query target and content-coverage plan, not 120 observed rankings, search-volume estimates or guaranteed wins. Only the exact user query has a limited personalized Google result observation.
metadata.normalization: Unicode NFKC + casefold + punctuation-to-space + collapsed whitespace; no duplicates under that normalization. Intent-level review also avoids word-order, city-spelling and simple keyword substitutions.

coverage_definitions.existing: The current public page directly answers the specific question; this does not establish Google indexation or ranking.
coverage_definitions.preview: The LetsAimIt blog page hosts a short attributed preview; full content is linked on LinkedIn, with no first-party article-detail route.
coverage_definitions.gap: The current site lacks the requested answer or operational detail. target_url is an existing hub; proposed_path is a future suggestion, never a live URL claim.

index_evidence.blogs: Discovered – currently not indexed (GSC 20 Nov 2026). Root confirmed no last crawl; a live fetch and index request do not themselves establish indexing.
index_evidence.other_targets: Not individually inspected in this matrix. Successful HTTP fetches or source review are distinct from Google URL inspection.

priority_definitions.P1: Editorial priority for brand discovery, the current blog-indexation issue or information families need to decide or attend.
priority_definitions.P2: Useful substantive coaching, learning and parent guidance to prepare and review before publication.
priority_definitions.P3: Narrow practice-measurement interpretation that needs careful coach context; no benchmarks or outcome claims.

metadata.audit_action: One Google Search Console indexing request for /blogs/ was confirmed by the root audit; this is not an indexing confirmation.
